result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue where a loading spinner remains visible over a fully loaded restaurant card image.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner overlay is persistently displayed in the center of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' image even though the card and its image have already loaded.
issues.suggestion: Hide or remove the loading indicator state once the card image and data have finished loading, or ensure the global refresh spinner is properly dismissed after the pull-to-refresh completes.
